title: Add dev/test installer matrix

context.summary: Add dry-run installer validation across Linux, macOS and Windows fixtures.
context.background: The installer needs test coverage for different host environments without mutating the developer machine or requiring real dependency installation.

in: Add dry-run matrix validator using fake dependency probes.
Validate plan generation, redaction, compose profile selection and dependency diagnostics per OS fixture.
Add matrix validation to pnpm check.

acceptance_criteria: Fixture answer files exist for Linux, macOS and Windows.
Matrix validator runs without Docker, network or filesystem mutation outside temp paths.
Each fixture produces a valid install plan and redacted summary.
Dependency failures are represented as diagnostics rather than uncaught errors.
pnpm check includes installer matrix validation.

manual_checks: Confirm validator uses fake probes and does not start Docker.

risks: Fixtures must not contain real secrets.
The matrix must stay deterministic across host OSes.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
